Overview of Chungcheongnam-do Region (Chungcheongnam-do)

Chungcheongnam-do Region (Chungcheongnam-do) is located in the Chungcheongnam-do region of South Korea, with its prefectural capital at Cheonan. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Historic cultural district, Traditional market (Sijang), Mountain & river parks, Local museum & heritage trail.

RegionChungcheongnam-do
Capital cityCheonan
Cities & municipalities31
Primary transport hubCheonan Central Station (KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail)

How to get to Chungcheongnam-do Region

Connected via KORAIL KTX / SRT high-speed rail, Express Bus terminals, and T-money nationwide transit card. Use our KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Chungcheongnam-do

When visiting cities across Chungcheongnam-do, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Korean BBQ (Samgyeopsal & Hanwoo)
  • Bibimbap
  • Kimchi jjigae
  • Tteokbokki & street food
  • Local makgeolli

Best time to visit Chungcheongnam-do

Best time to visit Chungcheongnam-do: Apr–May, Sep–Nov.
